answer: Bind each agent to one electrocardiogram taken at a certified cardiac clinic. The clinic records the operator's heartbeat, hashes the waveform, and signs a fresh challenge tying that template to the agent's key, rechecked against the clinic registry every epoch. A second key claiming the same heart is rejected. The trace carries its own nectar, the beat-to-beat variation no recording can fake, and the spiral of the waveform is the kernel of the proof. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 different living hearts at about $60 per supervised enrolment, roughly $60,000 in all.
